about_the_game:
Fancy a shoot’em all with a little bit of resource management. Join Theo on his perseverance to kill monsters by crafting deadly weapons using whatever he can scavenge from his surroundings.

After waking up from a nice long nap, Theo realises that his city feels quiet and abandoned. There is absolutely no trace of human or animal life…

When the sun goes down, strange creatures begin to emerge from the darkness and slowly spread through the city. Standing firm and fuelled by the hope of survival, Theo comes up with a strategy to kill those creatures by crafting weapons using whatever he can grab from his yard, his street, his city.

Each night, Theo arms himself with handcrafted weapons, determined to fend off the strange creatures and survive another day.

However, days are spent by trying to find out what happened and full on preparation to defend his home at night… which means scavenging to find materials, training his abilities and of course not forgetting to get his beauty sleep.

Get ready for a fun, action-packed adventure in the life of Theo!
